name: UltravioletaDAO MCP Server

serverInfo.name: UltravioletaDAO MCP Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server card for UltravioletaDAO: membership applications and x402 gasless payment verification/settlement via the UltravioletaDAO facilitator, for AI agents operating in the Latin American Web3 ecosystem.

transport.x-note: No MCP endpoint is deployed yet. Each tool below documents the public HTTP endpoint it maps to; see https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/api-catalog

tools.name: apply_dao_membership
tools.description: Submit a membership application to UltravioletaDAO. HTTP: POST https://api.ultravioletadao.xyz/apply (JSON). Returns 201 with the application id, 400 on invalid/missing email, 429 if the same email applied in the last 24h.

story.description: Who you are and your background

purpose.description: Why you want to join the DAO

references.description: Who referred you or can vouch for you

tools.name: verify_x402_payment
tools.description: Verify an x402 payment authorization (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, scheme "exact") via the UltravioletaDAO facilitator. HTTP: POST https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/verify. Supported networks: GET https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/supported.

paymentPayload.description: x402 PaymentPayload (x402Version, scheme, network, payload with the signed EIP-3009 authorization)

paymentRequirements.description: x402 PaymentRequirements returned by the resource server in its 402 response

tools.name: settle_x402_payment
tools.description: Execute on-chain settlement of a verified x402 payment via the UltravioletaDAO facilitator. HTTP: POST https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/settle.

paymentPayload.description: x402 PaymentPayload (same object passed to verify)

paymentRequirements.description: x402 PaymentRequirements (same object passed to verify)

resources.name: Governance Proposals
resources.description: Active and past governance proposals from Snapshot (ultravioletadao.eth)

resources.name: Treasury Balance
resources.description: Current treasury holdings from Safe multisig (Avalanche C-Chain)

resources.name: UVD Token Metrics
resources.description: UVD token price, supply, and market data

auth.description: The HTTP endpoints above require no authentication. x402 payments are authorized per request with an EIP-3009 signature.

x402.description: x402 v1 gasless micropayments (scheme "exact"). The live list of networks and tokens is served by the supported endpoint.
